written: 2026-11-05, before any implementation of AQUA_RECALL_FOLLOWUP_V2 or the forgotten-text fixes
note: Independent synthetic cases for follow-up admission and forgotten-text privacy. New fictional names; none from semantic-recall-live v1/v2 or the existing recall tests. Expected outcomes follow the approved design (admission table: link E2/E1/C2/C1 x relation; anchored vs meaning-only seeds; per-root budget 2, meaning-only 1, total 3). P = the seed (earlier statement), L = later statements. Each history also gets the grader's neutral fillers (days 60-67).

contract.followUp: an excerpt quoted because it continues a chosen one has why 'follow-up', relation in [correction, closure, update, revalue, decision, change, speculative, mention] and hedged (boolean, true only for a speculative statement)

modes.keyword: selectRecall(units, question, {allUnderChars: 0, k, followUps}) - the production keyword path; the seed must win the single ranked seat (k=1)
modes.meaning: selectRecall(..., {semantic}) with synthetic cosines: seed 0.75, every other passage 0.45 - the seed is admitted by meaning only, no keyword overlap
modes.turn: recallForTurn (production entry) with the owner's forgets recorded through recallRedactions.redactPhrases / redactAllBefore; ranked (allUnderChars 0)

contract.preconditions: with followUps 0: the seed is selected (why 'match' in keyword mode, 'semantic' in meaning mode) and no expected target is selected - so every follow-up outcome is decided by the follow-up step alone; no case text is classified sensitive (so privacy cases test the forget list, not the sensitivity policy)
